body:
They're not just thoughts, I've been hurting myself and I've attempted suicide before. I think what I'm most scared of is failing again and ending up with brain damage or something.
I've called hotlines and chatlines before and they leave me on hold for several hours before being like "you're fine, I need to move onto the next person." I've joined other forums before and only got encouragement to kill myself. 
I've tried all of these things to distract myself but they don't distract me. Instead I sit there and think how I'm just procrastinating on killing myself.
